name: GitHub AI Radar Daily
description: Daily AI project radar: search the web for notable GitHub AI projects, gather Brave LLM context, and maintain one rolling Canvas page.

radar_query.value: latest notable open source GitHub AI projects agents developer tools new releases

youtube_query.value: github trending AI open source projects latest

steps.description: Find the existing radar Canvas page
Search for current GitHub AI project signals
Gather Brave LLM Context snippets for the radar
Find a recent YouTube video to feature on the Canvas page
Crawl and validate search result pages
Save validated source pages to stash
Create the radar page on first run
Refresh the existing radar page as a full-page update

success_speech: GitHub AI Radar complete. I updated ${radar_title} with today's snapshot.
partial_speech: GitHub AI Radar partially complete. I updated the Canvas page with the evidence available.
abort_speech: I couldn't complete the GitHub AI Radar run.
